name: @dspack-studio/composer-core
description: Pure data layer of the catalog composer: the project manifest schema, x-bootstrap ledger reading (WebCrypto, isomorphic), the normalized finding shape, the shared emit seam (one emit loop for the agent and the browser), and the adapter manifests binding the three existing seams (discovery / mapping / rendering) by reference. No protocol dependencies, no React, no Node-only APIs.
